archetype: pressure-zoned mountain research, quarantine and specimen-containment laboratory
containment_workflow: sample receiving, wet laboratory and clinical/infirmary rooms
sample preparation, cold storage and isolation support
upper analysis, microscopy, records/data, offices and observation control
staged containment-wing decontamination and controlled circulation spine
multiple quarantine rooms with insulating-glass observation
lead-lined specimen chamber with observation window and airlock
rear radioactive-waste processing and air-filtration plant
circulation: north intake branches through explicit pressure thresholds to west research and east containment
two independent six-rise stairs serve the complete research level
a controlled cross-connector joins research and containment without bypassing decontamination
rear utility annex links to research and has an independent south emergency exit
east loading exit serves waste and filtration without crossing public intake
damage_constraints: confine western collapse to the wet-lab and upper-analysis frontage
confine eastern breach to the specimen chamber and adjacent roof
preserve intake, clinical rooms, both stairs, quarantine and rear utilities
preserve waste processing, service loading and south emergency egress
derive mixed raider/infected occupation from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the stepped wings read as a controlled laboratory rather than one flat shell
intake, research, clinical, quarantine, containment and waste functions are recognizable
both research stairs and both independent exterior exits work at player scale
quarantine observation and specimen-chamber airlock have usable clearances
mixed hostile occupation remains dangerous without blocking mandatory pressure-zone routes
terrain feathering and retaining shoulders seat the laboratory into mountain terrain
